Evelyn,

- Eng leads: we need a two-week KT schedule and a plan for critical on-call/runbook handoffs. Also confirm equipment return process and repo/credential revocation timing.

I attached an initial checklist. Let's triage in a quick call today if possible — 11am PT or 3pm PT. Tell me what works.

Thanks,

- Add mutual non-disparagement clause limited to public statements; carve-out for factual references to employment dates/roles.

- Confirm there's no pending HR investigation (I checked HR records; none). If there were, I'd recommend a narrower release.
- Suggest including a clause clarifying continuation of access for the purpose of transitioning code/docs (time-limited and revocable).

I attached a redlined doc: redline_severance_v1.docx. Once Monica confirms the commercial terms, I'm fine with sending this to Ryan via DocuSign. Recommend we include an optional 30-minute call with counsel available (Patricia Willoughby) to answer legal questions.

Subject: Ryan — separation terms and next steps

Ryan — thank you again for the early notice and for offering to help with the transition. Below is a snapshot of agreed next steps and links to the paperwork.

Summary of commercial terms (subject to your signature):
- 8 weeks base salary severance (gross), payable on the next payroll after signed release.
- Pro-rated Q2 bonus paid per normal schedule.
- Medical continuation through July 31, 2026.
- Outplacement stipend: $1,250.

Process and timeline:
- Legal/HR will finalize the release; we've attached the final PDF. Please review. We plan to send via DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/ABCDEF-ryan-sev
- Knowledge transfer: see Drive folder for schedule. Markus will lead two deep-dive sessions and pairing.
- Access/equipment: privileged keys will be revoked at 6/11 17:00 PT; CI tokens removed by 6/12 09:00 PT. Laptop pickup/drop-off will be arranged by People Ops (laptop_return_form.pdf attached).

If this is acceptable, please sign the DocuSign envelope when you receive it and we'll confirm payment and final logistics. If you'd like a short call with outside counsel (Patricia Willoughby) before signing, we can set that up — available windows Mon 6/7 9–11am PT or Tue 6/8 1–3pm PT.

Again — appreciate your willingness to help for the next two weeks. Let me know if you have any concerns.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
